name: B10-0518/2025 (The Left) – Rule of law and human rights situation in Tunisia, particularly the case of Sonia Dahmani
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the rule of law and human rights situation in Tunisia, particularly the case of Sonia Dahmani
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion and making requests. It asks Tunisia to release lawyer Sonia Dahmani and others jailed only for speaking out, and to drop the charges against her and her sister. It also asks the European Union to review its 2023 migration deal with Tunisia, because of human rights abuses, and to put human rights first in future talks.

- No law changes; Parliament asks Tunisia to free Sonia Dahmani and drop charges.
- Affects her, her sister, other detainees, and the European Union's migration deal with Tunisia.
- Next: the European Union reviews the deal; the text goes to European Union bodies and Tunisia.
